$about.what: PROPS ids and labels as the page holds them. Prop geometry is code, not data: propDef(kind, shape, color) builds each prop from the shape's anchors (line 1283). This file serialises the data and describes the code; prop paths for the six presets are in cast.json (resolved).
$about.exported: 2026-11-13, Look Demo v5, Playwright (playwright-core 1.63.0) with Chrome 157 headless, 1440 x 900 viewport, deviceScaleFactor 2; values read from the page's own constants and functions at runtime

keys.glyph: drawn by glyph() at 16-32 px (GLYPH_PROPS); every other prop is left out of the flat glyph
keys.anchor: what the prop is placed on, described from propDef(); tx, ty is the shape's top anchor, vx, vy, vw, vh its visor, half-width is geom().hw(y) floored at 8
keys.shapeExceptions: shapes with a dedicated branch in propDef()
keys.tones: TONE key per layer (colors.json), or derived from the body color
keys.layerMaterial: light model per layer: vinyl for hard tones, felt otherwise
keys.decoClasses: animated vector decoration on top of the layers (glint, stitch, beam)
keys.decoClippedToBody: decoration clipped to the body outline
keys.workMotion: what the prop does while Working (and at 0.3 strength while Needs you, for rotating props)
keys.fiddleKind: PROP_FID: the idle "plays with its prop" move; bob = a greeting lift only, none = no move
keys.idleFiddle: the prop has an idle fiddle (FIDDLE)

props.name: Antennae
props.anchor: top anchor (tx, ty): two stalks with ball tips at (tx +/- 22.5, ty - 15.5)
props.workMotion: rotate about the stalk foot, 5 deg amplitude, 0.45 s period

props.name: Dish antenna
props.anchor: top anchor: a mast, the dish (body color mixed 55% to white) and a feed rod
props.workMotion: rotate about the mast foot, 14 deg, 1.5 s

props.name: Glasses
props.anchor: visor: lens centres on the eye centres (vx + 0.3 vw, vx + 0.7 vw) on the visor centre line, outer radius 10.5, inner 8.4
props.workMotion: the glint brightens: opacity 0.25 + 0.7 x work, 1.5 s

props.name: Seam
props.anchor: top anchor and the half-width at ty + 16: a curved stitched line, drawn as decoration clipped to the body; no layers of its own
props.workMotion: the stitch runs: dash offset -12 per 1.6 s

props.name: Beanie
props.anchor: top anchor and the half-width at ty + 12 (at least 16): the hat in the body color mixed 50% to #0d0b0c, the band and pompom 22% lighter

props.name: Headlamp
props.anchor: top anchor and the half-width at ty + 13: a strap across the head at ty + 15, the housing at ty + 5 to ty + 16, a lens; the beam is decoration, invisible at rest
props.workMotion: the beam lights: opacity 0.55 x work

props.name: Periscope
props.anchor: top anchor: a tube rising 21 units and a head with a lens
props.workMotion: rotate about the tube foot, 7 deg, 1.2 s

props.name: Magnifier
props.anchor: visor: the ring centred at (vx + vw - 3, visor centre + 3), radius 11.5, a wooden handle down and to the right

props.name: Pennant
props.anchor: top anchor: a pole rising 26 units and a triangular flag
props.workMotion: rotate about the pole at the flag, 9 deg, 0.8 s

props.name: Flower clip
props.anchor: right of the visor centre line by min(0.55 x half-width at ty + 11, 17), at y = min(ty + 8, vy - 11); on the kettle it is seated on the handle at (77, 38); 1.5x scale

props.name: Plaster
props.anchor: left of the top anchor by min(0.45 x half-width at ty + 14, 16), at ty + 15: two crossed strips

props.name: Sprout
props.anchor: top anchor: a stem and two leaves
props.workMotion: rotate about the stem foot, 7 deg, 1.2 s

props.name: Badge
props.anchor: visor right edge: a clip and a card at (vx + vw + 2, visor centre + 6)

props.name: Wind-up key
props.anchor: top anchor: a shaft and a two-lobed bow above it
props.workMotion: the key turns about its shaft: horizontal scale cos(t) with a floor of 0.14, 1.6 s

props.name: Monocle
props.anchor: right eye centre (vx + 0.7 vw, visor centre), radius min(10.6, 0.4 x vh); a bead chain to a pin on the cheek, found by scanning the half-width below the visor; on the safe the pin moves 16 units in from the visor's right edge to clear the handle
props.workMotion: focus: 6% scale in and out about the eye, 1.5 s; the glint brightens as on the glasses

props.name: Quill
props.anchor: top anchor: a feather tucked into the crown, its quill rising up and to the right
props.workMotion: rotate about the quill foot, 7 deg, 1.2 s

props.name: Red flag
props.anchor: top anchor: a pole rising 26 units and a red triangular flag
props.workMotion: rotate about the pole at the flag, 9 deg, 0.8 s

props.name: Lightning
props.anchor: top anchor: a lightning bolt stuck into the crown at ty + 4, tip down, 1.6x scale, leaning 12 deg right
props.workMotion: a crackle about the tip: 6 deg at 10 Hz fading over 0.3 s, then still until 1.3 s

fit.$about: Measured for this package (not page data): every prop on every shape, rasterised at 4 px per unit over the viewBox, layers only (decoration excluded). bbox: [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the layers. overflowsViewBox: any layer outside -8..128 x -14..114. outsideBody: share of prop pixels outside the body and its parts. visorCovered: share of the visor area under the prop. crownCovered: share of the Partial coverage crown (body above crownLine) under the prop. Seam has no layers.
